content: Isra7eele Asay Kawo Kawoththanaas Shiishshida Oysha
Sameeli cimmida wode ba nayta nam7ata Isra7eele bolla pirdana mala shuumides.
Izas bayra naazi Iyu7eele geetettees; kaalozi Abiya geetettees; istti Bersaabehen pirdeettes.
Gido attiin nayti bantta aawa oge kaallibeettenna; bessontta go7a demmanaas gishe ogeppe kezida; maganxo ekkidi pirda geellasida.
Hessa gishshas Isra7eele cimati wuri issi bolla shiiqidi Sameeli dizaso Eraama yida.
Isttika Sameelas, «Neni cimadasa; ne nayti ne lose kaallettenna; hessa gishshas hara kawoteththati ooththiza mala nuna kaaleththiza kawo nuus kawoththa» gida.
Gido attiin, «Nuna kaaleththiza kawo nuus kawoththa» gidayssi Sameela mishisida gishshas Sameeli GODAA woossides.
GODAYKKA Sameelas zaaridi, «Ta isttas kawo gidontta mala istti kadhiday tana attiin nena gidontta gishshas derezi gizayssa ubbaa siya.
Ta istta Gibxe biittafe kesoosofe hanno gakkanaas tana aggidi hara eeqa xoossatas goynnishe ooththida mala ne bollaka ooththeettes.
Neni gidikko istti nena gizayssa siya; istta bolla kawotidayssi istta bolla ay ooththanaakko istta erisa bessiza mala isttas minththa yoota» gides.
Sameelikka kawo kawoththanaas oychchida deraas GODAA qaala ubbaa yootides.
Isttas, «Intte bolla kawotana kawozi intte bolla ooththanayssi intte attuma nayta ubbaa ekkidi para-gaare laaggizaytanne toganchchata kessana; istti para-gaareta sinththan woxxana.

Istta giddofe issota issota shaalaqata, mato halaqata, hamsa halaqata histtana; baggata iza gade goyana malanne iza kath shiishshana mala, ola massaratanne para-gaares gidiza miishshata ooththizayta histtana.
Intte macca nayta ekkidi shitto kessisana; woxe kathisananne sollo uukisana.
Intte gadeppe, woyne gadeppenne wogara tokkiza gadeppe lo7oso lo7oso ekkidi ba shuumetas immana.
Izi intte kaththaafenne intte woyne miththaafe tammaafe issaa ba kawoteththan diza ba oosanchchatassinne ba shuumetas immana.
Attumanne macca intte aylleta, intte meheppe doorettida lo7ota lo7ota baas histtana.
Dorsa wudeppenne deysha wudeppe tammaafe issi kusheza baas ekkana; intte intte hu7era iza aylleta gidana.
Hessi intte bolla gakkida wode intte dosidi doorida kawozappe dendidayssan waassana. Gido attiin GODAY he gallas intte waaso siyenna» gides.
Derey gidikko Sameeli haasayza qaalaza wudan yeggontta ixxidi, «Gidenna; nuus kawoy kawotana mala koyoos.
Hara dereta mala nunikka nuna kaaleththizaade, nu sinththara bizaadenne nuus olettiza kawoy diza kawoteth gidana» gida.
Sameelikka derezi gizayssa ubbaa siyides; hessa zaaridi GODAAS yootides.
GODAYKKA, «Istti gizayssa siya; kawokka isttas kawoththa» gides; hessafe guye Sameeli Isra7eele asaa, «Issoy issoy intte yida katama katama simmi biite» gides.
